en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s top court quashes autistic man’s conviction for flag desecration citing his condition
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s top court has quashed an autistic man’s conviction for flag desecration, ruling that medical evidence showed he may have been affected by conditions characterised by hypersensitivity to visual stimuli.



China and Hong Kong flags at Central Market on Oct. 1, 2022. File photo: Lea Mok/HKFP.
